title: DESIGN
description: Engineering, internal. Never crosses a department boundary, which is why it is not in the spine - but it is typed for the same reason everything else is.

oDiff.description: The O-layer diff in the future tense. A design is an orientation doc at an earlier point in time, not a second artifact.

proposes.description: How a change argues an existing constraint is wrong. A proposal, resolved before the code lands - never landed alongside it.

failureModes.description: Required. A change that adds a failure mode without the signal that detects it is incomplete.
